title: Proper U.S. Lane-to-Lane Left/Right Turns & Counter-Clockwise Roundabout

no_head_on_same_lane.note: No opposing vehicles facing each other in same lane; left cars side-by-side northbound, right cars in different positions.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Top-down vehicles only, no steering wheel or cabin interior visible.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signal present in either panel.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Vehicles keep right with double-yellow center to left of approach lanes; turns land in correct halves and roundabout circulates counter-clockwise.

teaching_correct.note: Left turn to nearest left lane, right turn to nearest right lane, and CCW circulation with yield at entry are geometrically correct.
